name: DGME medical and dental college lists — Khulna Division
organization: Directorate General of Medical Education (DGME), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
attribution: Source: Directorate General of Medical Education (dgme.gov.bd)
notes: Same DGME HTML tables as the Rajshahi, Rangpur, Dhaka and Chattogram runs: 'সরকারি/বেসরকারি মেডিকেল কলেজ' (college code, name, year established, MBBS seats; page updated 18 Dec 2025) and 'সরকারি/বেসরকারি ডেন্টাল কলেজ/ইউনিট' (updated 20 May 2024). Rows kept when the name's district suffix (or a district name in it) is in Khulna Division. Army Medical College Jashore (listed in the private table without a college code) is marked ownership 'armed_forces'. English names/websites for government colleges come from the 'সরকারী মেডিকেল কলেজ (সকল)' page, matched by district where the district has one government MBBS college; that page lists only Khulna, Magura and Satkhira of this division. No addresses, phones or coordinates. Licence not stated.
